title: Urban Wit, Collective Catharsis, and Political Jokes

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The *pesti vicc* was Budapest's unofficial currency during war and dictatorship. Circulating purely through oral culture (*szájhagyomány*), it punctured total state control with instantaneous, wry (*fanyar*) humor.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The anatomy of the joke relies on a sudden conceptual twist (*csattanó, poén*) that unmasks official hypocrisy through common sense.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A pesti vicc mint a szellem önvédelme...
The Budapest joke as the self-defense of the mind...
Unmasking power with a single punchline...
